methodology.discovery: Daily Keepa Best Sellers snapshots from the exact Amazon novelty T-shirt browse nodes
methodology.momentum: Change in each ASIN's position within its daily category Best Sellers list
methodology.new_entrants: ASINs absent from the prior snapshot are listed separately and never receive an imputed momentum score
methodology.enrichment: Metadata is queried only for top candidates; no product-history query is required
methodology.merch_detection: Merch by Amazon boilerplate in the feature bullets, with a direct Amazon offer as a secondary confirm
methodology.blended_score: 45% 24h percentile + 35% 7d percentile + 20% current-rank percentile, computed across the full category population and renormalized when a component is unavailable
